name: hiring_brief
description: Generate a Weekly Hiring Update PDF report for an executive leader. Includes a KPI banner (Current HC, Open Positions, Future HC, and optionally Forecast and % to Plan), a headcount-by-organization table grouped by the next level down, and a Progress / Problems / Plans narrative drafted by AI and reviewed by the user. Targeted for the recruiting team to produce for leadership. Supports the top-level executive (the leader at the very top of the company's management hierarchy — full company), leaders one level below the top of the hierarchy, and leaders two levels below the top. Triggers: weekly hiring update, hiring update PDF, hiring report, recruiting report, leader hiring update, weekly recruiting summary, hiring update for [leader name]. Do NOT use for: live recruiting metrics (use good_morning_recruiting) or headcount trend analysis (use headcount_insights).
